item.title: Major Enterprise Software Vendors Roll Out Autonomous AI Agent Platforms in 2026
item.description:
Major Enterprise Software Vendors Roll Out Autonomous AI Agent Platforms in 2026

In 2026, enterprise AI agents are becoming a primary software investment area as businesses shift from basic chatbots to systems that understand business context, access corporate data, and execute multi-step workflows. Major vendors—including Microsoft, Salesforce, Google, ServiceNow, and SAP—are pursuing distinct platform strategies while shifting pricing away from simple flat-rate seat models toward metered consumption.

🔍 Market Shift and Pricing Complexity

As vendors transition to agentic platforms, pricing models are diversifying. Enterprises now encounter a combination of seat licenses, consumption charges, actions, credits, conversations, and AI usage units. Because each vendor meters work differently, CIOs increasingly measure cost per completed business process rather than headline license prices.

⚙️ Vendor Architectures and Pricing

The primary software providers offer distinct technical integrations and pricing structures:

Vendor Agent Technologies Pricing and Licensing Structure
Microsoft Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Agent 365 • Microsoft 365 Copilot: $30/user/month (paid annually)
• Standalone Copilot Studio: $200/month for 25,000 Copilot Credits (requires Azure subscription)
• Pay-as-you-go pricing also available
Salesforce Agentforce, Agentforce Builder, Agent Script, Data 360, Salesforce Trust Layer • Flex Credits: $500 for 100,000 credits (standard action consumes 20 credits; voice consumes 30)
• User License: $5/user/month (requires Flex Credits)
• Conversation Pricing: $2/conversation
• Flat-fee Option: $125/user/month for some configurations
Google Gemini Enterprise, Agent Designer, Agent Development Kit • Business Edition: $21/seat/month
• Standard & Plus Editions: $30/seat/month
• Pay-as-you-go Model: No seat fee; pays for tokens, memory, compute, and storage (limited availability)
ServiceNow Enterprise workflow-native agents Built directly into existing enterprise workflows
SAP Joule Integrated directly with finance, HR, procurement, and supply-chain processes

🧩 Corporate Adoption and Results

Enterprises are already deploying these platforms to manage workflows and automate processes:

  • Atos: In June 2026, Atos deployed Microsoft 365 Copilot to 56,000 employees across 54 countries. The company is using Agent 365 to manage approximately 19,000 AI agents designed via Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry to handle internal IT, business functions, and customer deployments.
  • Tata Realty and Infrastructure: Deployed Salesforce Agentforce to manage customer engagement, reducing first-response times from days to eight hours. The deployment resulted in a 30 percent increase in lead qualification, a 10 percent rise in conversion rates, and email open rates of 50-60 percent.
  • KPMG: Achieved a 90 percent employee adoption rate of Gemini Enterprise and created more than 100 custom agents during its first month of deployment.

#EnterpriseAI #AIAgents #MicrosoftCopilot #SalesforceAgentforce #GoogleGemini

Source: Enterprise AI Agents 2026: Microsoft, Salesforce, Google, ServiceNow and SAP Pricing, Customers and Technology Compared - InfotechLead

item.title: Kier Group integrates AI tools and develops custom agents
item.description:
Kier Group integrates AI tools and develops custom agents

Kier Group plc, a construction and infrastructure services company based in Salford, England, has adopted AI tools and is developing custom AI agents to enhance operations.

🔍 Overview

Kier Group plc, with roughly 11,000 employees, builds schools, prisons, and large-scale water and nuclear energy projects. The company began embracing AI two years ago.

⚙️ Key details

  • About 40 percent of colleagues use Microsoft 365 Copilot.
  • The remaining employees use Teams Premium, which includes advanced AI features for chat and meetings.
  • Copilot is used within Outlook, Excel, Teams, and PowerPoint.
  • Data is securely stored on Microsoft’s Azure cloud platform.

🤖 AI agents in development

Kier is in the early stages of developing AI agents for specific use cases.

AI Agent Purpose
Safety data agent Collects and organizes safety data for analysis to address risk areas and forward-looking actions.
Safety standards agent Trained on Kier safety standards and linked to job site photographs, equipment images, and drone video.
Response time agent Designed to speed up response times while allowing direct human interaction when needed.

🏗️ Additional applications

  • Drones reduce the need for people to work at height or interact with certain environments.
  • AI is being considered for facilities management to predict servicing needs for building parts like pumps or elevators.

#AI #KierGroup #MicrosoftCopilot #AIagents #construction #infrastructure

Source: How Kier Group’s Louisa Finlay is using Copilot to drive safety and productivity in the construction industry - Source EMEA
